function.name: move_to
function.arguments: {"targets": {"x": -0.05, "y": 0.025, "z": 0.86, "gripper": 0.5}, "note": "Servo tracking lags the reference and non-gripper moves only run 2 steps, so I command an intermediate gripper value (which the adapter latches to stay open) to get a long interpolated motion; this lets the arm settle onto the pre-grasp hover at (-0.05, 0.025, 0.86), just above the block top, before the final approach."}
